messages:
jon-billing: Heads up: customer Meridian Care (acct: MC-7742) hit ACH onboarding failure. Bank webhook: 'account_type_mismatch' on microdeposits. Invoice 52333 ($3,950) is due tomorrow; customer asking if we can accept a one-time wire to avoid service impact.
rita-payments: Can you paste the raw bank note? Might be business vs personal checking.
jon-billing: Webhook payload: status=failed, decline_code=account_type_mismatch, bank_message='Microdeposit not supported for account type'. Customer says they used their corporate account.
ops-oncall: Pause autopay retries for MC-7742 to avoid duplicate charges.
billing-bot: Payment attempt 2027-01-15 13:44 UTC (txn: pay_k7m1) failed. Retry scheduled per billing policy.
nora-finance: Amount <$50k so standard approval. Two asks: (1) customer must confirm they will cover any outgoing bank fees for wire; (2) need signed one-off billing addendum for audit.
jon-billing: Customer emailed back: "we can include bank fees" and asked for wire details + remittance email.
rita-payments: @jon-billing FYI: small international wires sometimes get intermediary fees deducted; remind them to include fees or we accept net with signed exception.
cecilia-vpfinance: Approved to accept a one-time wire for invoice 52333 ($3,950). Conditions: remittance email to billing@redwood.ai with bank trace, upload of wire confirmation to the billing folder, and signed addendum attached. No contract changes.
jon-billing: Sending wiring instructions now and attaching pro-forma. Paused autopay retries and cc'd support+finance.
jon-billing: Wire details (sent):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Metropolitan Bank
Routing (ABA): 111000025
Account: 2233445566
SWIFT: MBINUS66
Reference: Invoice 52333 - MC-7742
Remittance email: billing@redwood.ai
Note: Please include the full invoice amount and cover intermediary fees so Redwood receives the net amount due.
```
ops-oncall: Confirmed: support paused retries and added ticket note to avoid duplicate charges.
billing-bot: Flag created: MANUAL_WIRE-1012. Attach signed addendum and remittance trace for audit.
jon-billing: Customer replied: "Wire initiated; will send trace once available."
nora-finance: Once trace posts I'll reconcile and close. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
